messages:
sam: Heads-up — scheduled cutover in ~2h for release/2026. We need a final decision on provider pin + IAM role split before I hit apply.
nina: On it. I'll run a fast `terraform plan` and paste any surprises. leaving phone nearby.
deploybot: queued: apply-slot 1763009-serial; preflight checks started.
    preflight summary:
    - state lock: ok
    - drift snapshot: routes (route53) warning
    - provider version: pinned 3.74 (candidate)
    - kms rotation pending: NO
ara: Thx. Rollback criteria proposal:
    - production 5xx > 1% over 5m
    - median P95 latency increase > 30s
    - any IAM binding failures on create/update
    If hit any of the above during canary, immediate rollback to previous tfstate and provider swap.

devin: Quick note: the plan shows one IAM role replacement in east-1 (service-account-role). If that replaces, we should pause cutover and run manual migration path (attach policies then swap). Don't let the apply replace it blindly.
leo: +1. Also recommend we keep provider pinned during the window. If a hotfix needed, we can revert to 3.72 which we've smoke-tested this month.
sam: Nina — paste plan snippet when ready. If the plan is clean (no IAM replace) I want to run us-west-2 then wait 3m, then us-east-1. Canary will be tenant-alpha only.
nina: plan paste:
```
# module.network.aws_route53_record.api: 0 to change
# module.iam.aws_iam_role.service-account-role: ~> replacement planned (force new resource)
# module.compute.aws_autoscaling_attachment.asg_attach: create
```
nina: Looks like the IAM role replace is flagged in east-1 only. west-2 is fine.
ara: Given that, proposal: proceed with us-west-2 apply now, hold before east-1. If any role replace shows we run the role-swap playbook instead of apply. I'm oncall and can jump if needed.
sam: Agree. deploybot — please run west-2 apply only (serial), and hold the east-1 job. Tag the east-1 job with `hold:iam-replace`.
deploybot: apply started for us-west-2 (slot 1763009-A). streaming logs -> https://deploybot/reports/1763009-A

deploybot: us-west-2 apply completed: success, no drift, no replacements.
sam: nice. Waiting 3m for metrics. Nina, watch error budget + 5xx.
nina: watching. so far p95 stable, errors 0.2%.

ara: If at any point we see IAM binding errors post-apply, run rollback command:
```
# rollback sequence
deploybot rollback --slot 1763009-A --reason "iam-bind-fail"
terraform state pull > pre-cutover.tfstate
```

devin: One more: update release notes to indicate east-1 will be manual migration due to role replacement. Add instructions for support on how to surface if they see missing permissions.
sam: Will update release notes and pin them here.
sam: Release notes (short):
- Cutover: staged, west-2 completed. east-1 paused due to IAM role replacement.
- Action: Platform team will run role-swap playbook for service-account-role in east-1.
- Rollback triggers: 5xx>1%, P95 latency regressed >30s, IAM binding failures.

leo: Thanks team. After role-swap is validated we'll resume east-1 apply and un-tag `hold:iam-replace`.
ara: I'm online for the east-1 manual step. ping me when you want me in the channel.
sam: Marking this thread resolved for west-2. Keeping east-1 open as `hold` until manual migration completes. :thumbsup:
